title: Why Your App Needs a Router
excerpt: Learn how URLs make web applications easier to navigate and share.
body: Routing connects each URL to the appropriate screen in an application. It supports direct navigation, browser history, and shareable links.

title: Getting Started with React
excerpt: Discover the fundamentals of building interfaces with reusable components.
body: React helps developers build user interfaces from reusable components. Components can receive props, manage state, and compose together to create complete pages.

title: Why TypeScript Matters
excerpt: Explore how static typing improves the development experience.
body: TypeScript adds static type checking to JavaScript. It helps developers discover many mistakes during development and improves editor autocomplete.

title: Styling with Tailwind CSS
excerpt: Build consistent interfaces using utility-first CSS classes.
body: Tailwind CSS provides utility classes for styling layouts, typography, spacing, colors, and responsive designs directly in markup.

title: Modern Web Development
excerpt: Understand how today's frontend tools work together.
body: Modern frontend applications combine component-based interfaces, typed code, routing, styling tools, and build systems to create maintainable web experiences.
